title: OnlyJoin
description: Makes it so only Low Tier 3 or better ranked players can join your minecraft server
body:
# OnlyJoin

Only Join is a plugin i made for GalaxyPrac (my own server) to allow only players ranked LT3 or better join my server.

**OnlyJoin is used by these servers (Contact me on discord galaxia_000 to have your server added to this list!):**

- GalaxyPrac
